name: invompt
description: Invompt helps you create, review, revise, and deliver billing documents from a conversation.

interface.longDescription: Create or manage invoices from natural-language requests. Use the same workflow for quotes and estimates; a pro forma is represented as a quote. Reuse saved clients and settings, inspect hosted review links, revise the selected document, export an existing invoice as a PDF, or email the selected document after confirming the recipient. You control every document change and delivery; Invompt does not process payments.
